goal: Turn the studied editorial rhythm into an original nocturnal broadcast log where projects are transmissions and the scroll behaves like a tuning sequence.
core_concept: A fictional studio presented as a late-night signal room: timecodes, signal bands and a restrained chalk interface give each project the weight of a transmission received and archived.

composition_plan.spatial_system: A dark field uses a narrow timecode rail beside broad horizontal transmission bands; mobile turns the rail into a repeated top marker and stacks each band as a contained broadcast panel.
composition_plan.visual_hierarchy: The transmission statement and timecode dominate, signal bands frame project artifacts, serif annotations slow the reading, and the utility controls stay small and high-contrast.
composition_plan.pacing: Long dark intervals are interrupted by bright signal bands; each project enters as a self-contained transmission before the next quiet frequency.
composition_plan.density: Dense only at the metadata rail and signal headers; the project fields remain broad, legible and intentionally underfilled.

typography_plan.display_role: A heavy system sans carries short broadcast phrases and timecode numerals in stacked blocks; it is deliberately clipped by the band edge at desktop.
typography_plan.body_role: A system serif carries transmission notes with a slower, reflective voice against the dark field.
typography_plan.scale_strategy: Fluid display type preserves a strong horizontal silhouette on desktop and breaks into compact signal phrases on mobile.
typography_plan.contrast_strategy: Warm chalk, coral signal and faint blue grid lines create hierarchy through luminance and interruption rather than decorative gradients.
typography_plan.rhythm: Monospaced timecodes and uppercase utility labels punctuate wide serif notes and heavy sans transmission phrases.
typography_plan.responsive_behavior: The vertical rail becomes a horizontal status strip; clipped desktop bands become contained mobile panels with the same timecode order.

art_direction.imagery_strategy: Use CSS-authored signal bands, orbital rings, registration ticks and abstract broadcast forms as original stand-ins for studio work.
art_direction.asset_strategy: No external assets, logos, copied illustrations, source imagery, source fonts, source code or source copy; all material is authored in this variant.
art_direction.texture: Deep ink field with fine blue grid lines, scanline bands and sparse registration ticks authored in CSS.
art_direction.material: Night blue-black, warm chalk, coral-orange signal and a cold electric-blue grid suggest a tactile broadcast console without a literal device mockup.
art_direction.depth: Depth comes from offset signal layers, clipped bands and inset borders; no photographic media, WebGL or continuous ambient effect is necessary.
art_direction.layering: Timecode, signal header, artifact plane and afterimage marker occupy explicit z-levels within each transmission band.
art_direction.color_logic: Ink is the uninterrupted field; chalk is the reading layer, coral is the active signal, and electric blue marks measured structure.

signature_move.name: afterimage trace
signature_move.central_idea: The active transmission leaves a short offset trace behind its signal title, showing the project as a received event rather than a static card.
signature_move.trigger: pointer hover or keyboard focus on a transmission log
signature_move.visual_transformation: A coral bracket expands across the band, a translucent title trace settles one grid unit behind it and the timecode brightens.
signature_move.purpose: Make selection feel like tuning into a transmission while keeping motion attached to the project's identity and metadata.
signature_move.content_relationship: The trace repeats only the active transmission's short title and timecode; it does not introduce unrelated decoration.
signature_move.reduced_motion_alternative: Show the bracket, title trace and bright timecode statically on focus/hover with no translation or expansion.
signature_move.capture_checkpoint: desktop first transmission hover after the coral bracket and title trace are fully visible

scroll_storyboard: Timecode hero holds as a dark broadcast slate with one coral marker.
Signal-room principles alternate dense metadata with open serif notes.
Transmission logs enter as wide bands with changing alignment and quiet gaps.
Frequency index tightens the rhythm before the night desk contact.
transitions: opacity and translate transitions use canonical KINETIC motion tokens
afterimage trace uses canonical snap and med duration tokens
no autonomous carousel, video or looping animation
motion_plan.reduced_motion_behavior: Disable trace translation and reveal transforms; retain bracket, title trace, timecode emphasis, hierarchy and visible focus states.

retained_principles: media and copy alternate as a narrative rhythm
responsive composition changes structure rather than only scale
deliberately_rejected_principles: source font files and exact typesetting
warm paper shell and sculptural hero treatment
exact section geometry and hidden implementation

design_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use audited curated-design context for editorial composition comparison while the Wanaka DesignCase remains the primary reference.
knowledge_used: Curated website references are comparison evidence, not reusable source material.

motion_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited motion-study category to require observable transmission trigger and checkpoint states without copying implementation or media.
knowledge_used: Motion fidelity should be studied through explicit trigger and checkpoint states.

typography_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited typography-discovery category to reason about role pairing while selecting only system substitutes.
knowledge_used: Typeface roles and pairing can be evaluated independently of copying a proprietary font asset.

composition_differences: A dark horizontal transmission log and persistent timecode rail replace both V0's paper collage and V1's coordinate map.
Project entries are wide signal bands with a broadcast index, not offset portfolio cards or survey panels.
The contact close is a compact night desk rather than a full-bleed violet invitation.
typography_differences: Short clipped broadcast phrases and timecode numerals create the display voice instead of V0's open display manifesto.
Serif copy is used as a quiet transmission annotation against an ink field rather than as a dominant chapter heading.
motion_differences: The signature interaction is an offset afterimage trace and coral bracket, not V0's circle or V1's latitude scan.
Scroll pacing follows broadcast bands and signal gaps with a persistent timecode orientation strip.
originality_plan.asset_non_reuse: All imagery is newly authored CSS geometry; no Wanaka, V0 or V1 asset, logo, copy, artwork, font, code or project identity is reused.
originality_plan.signature_move_hypothesis: An identity-bound afterimage trace can make a selected transmission feel received and memorable without reducing the interaction to a decorative lift or generic fade.

quality_hypothesis: If an original night-signal composition preserves editorial hierarchy, whitespace, alternating media/copy rhythm and surface-attached response without repeating V0 or V1, the human review can distinguish grammar transfer from stylistic imitation.
